title: Codex Cloud implementation ledger
rule: 5 tasks per slice, done requires test and evidence

entries.title: Set 32x20 default; retain 24x15 and 16x10
entries.acceptance: State and UI tests assert default 32x20 and zoom cycle.

entries.title: Extract pure world/canvas pointer transforms
entries.acceptance: Roundtrips correct at every zoom, with letterbox margins.

entries.title: Implement integer camera follow and free pan
entries.acceptance: Tile coordinates remain stable; no subpixel blur.

entries.title: Protect crisp pixel-square scaling and safe areas
entries.acceptance: Canvas remains pixelated and never clips target cells.

entries.title: Capture 3 viewport sizes × zoom and verify commands
entries.acceptance: 9 screenshots and touch tests; 10 visible controls.

entries.title: Wire four starter PNG sheets through manifest into renderer
entries.acceptance: Runtime shows actual atlas pixels, all offline.

entries.title: Draw roads and water adjacency masks
entries.acceptance: Test joins, bends and edges without altering collision.

entries.title: Add deterministic nonblocking environmental props
entries.acceptance: World seed yields same placements after reload.

entries.title: Improve hamlet, shrine, ruin and camp silhouettes
entries.acceptance: Readable destinations at 32x20, no phantom interiors.

entries.title: Cache/invalidate scenery and profile before/after
entries.acceptance: Evidence of no stale tiles and bounded redraws.

entries.title: Draw Nim with four facings and 2–4 frame walk cycle
entries.acceptance: Movement animation derived from tick, not draw calls.

entries.title: Distinctively draw the three professions
entries.acceptance: Roles readable at 640x360 / 32x20.

entries.title: Add visual wolves and boars; defer unsimulated animals
entries.acceptance: Only existing enemy types rendered and tested.

entries.title: Show actions/goals without control prompts
entries.acceptance: Why/goal UI and activity legible with time sped up.

entries.title: Correct foot-Y sorting and tree occlusion
entries.acceptance: No invisible Nim behind foliage; test overlay order.

entries.title: Preview valid/invalid tile targeting
entries.acceptance: Invalid events cost no Faith; readable cursor.

entries.title: Render finite FX for bless/gift/bloom/guide/storm
entries.acceptance: All effects arise from simulator events, capped cost.

entries.title: Inspire a traveler with a unique role reaction
entries.acceptance: One click → one favor, correct chronicle/favor marker.

entries.title: Deduplicate visual effects without duplicate rewards
entries.acceptance: No render frame can mutate Faith or sim state.

entries.title: Implement reduced-motion and textual alternatives
entries.acceptance: Effects understandable without animation.

entries.title: Compact HUD and touch safe areas
entries.acceptance: No lost buttons or unreadable NPC info at 640x360.

entries.title: Run browser smoke, save roundtrip and 10k ticks
entries.acceptance: All tests green, no offline network needed.

entries.title: Build and verify v1 experimental debug APK
entries.acceptance: Signed ZIP manifest structurally valid; no keystore leaks.

entries.title: Collect physical Android evidence when device available
entries.acceptance: FPS, memory, 20min session; mark BLOCKED otherwise.

entries.title: Publish source, screenshots, APK and verification PR
entries.acceptance: Evidence exact; no unverified claims or accidental main merge.
